title: What Happens If You Stop Eating Sugar?
sources: Harvard Health, 'The sweet danger of sugar' (excess sugar linked to heart disease, obesity, diabetes)
NHS, 'Sugar: the facts' (recommended daily intake 30g free sugars; average consumption exceeds this)
Mayo Clinic, 'Added sugar: don't get sabotaged by sweeteners' (withdrawal symptoms: cravings, headaches, fatigue)

lines.text: What happens if you stop eating sugar?
For the first three days, your body panics.
You get headaches, you feel tired, and you crave sweets like crazy.
That is because sugar triggers the same reward pathway as drugs.
Your brain has been getting dopamine hits from sugar every single day.
When you cut it out, your brain throws a tantrum.
lines.caps: When you *cut it out | your brain | throws a *tantrum

lines.text: But by day four, something amazing happens.
Your energy levels stabilize, and your cravings start to fade.
Your skin clears up, your sleep improves, and your mood lifts.
The sugar crash you thought was normal was actually sugar all along.
lines.caps: The sugar *crash | you thought was *normal | was actually *sugar | all *along
